detailedExplanation: Heating transfers energy into a system. This can increase particle kinetic energy and therefore temperature, or it can increase particle potential energy during a change of state without increasing temperature.

This distinction is central to Year 9 thermal physics: temperature is not the same thing as total internal energy. A large object can contain more internal energy than a small object at the same temperature because it contains more particles.
